Australian Rugby League.name: Australian Rugby League
Australian Rugby League.summary: Australian Rugby League is a 1995 rugby game by Electronic Arts for the Sega Mega Drive released exclusively in Australia and Europe.

Iron Hammer.name: Iron Hammer
Iron Hammer.summary: Iron Hammer is a first-person tank combat game, originally developed for the Sega VR headset before being reworked into a standard Genesis title for distribution via Sega Channel. The finalized game was archived by the Video Game History Foundation and Gaming Alexandria in 2025.
